STANDING->SEATED.cue: Come down to seated on the mat

STANDING->KNEELING.cue: Lower down onto hands and knees

KNEELING->STANDING.cue: Step forward and rise to standing

SEATED->KNEELING.cue: Shift forward onto hands and knees

KNEELING->PRONE.cue: Lower gently down onto your stomach

PRONE->KNEELING.cue: Press up onto hands and knees

SEATED->SUPINE.cue: Roll gently down onto your back

SUPINE->SEATED.cue: Roll to your side and press up to seated

PRONE->SUPINE.cue: Roll smoothly over onto your back

SUPINE->PRONE.cue: Roll smoothly over onto your stomach
